## Why visit

A purposeful south-Liverpool choice supported by inclusion on Liverpool CAMRA's 2026 Pub of the Year shortlist. The former Pi bar now offers rotating traditional and modern cask ales in an informal neighbourhood room. It is most useful when combining a Smithdown/Wavertree outing, rather than as part of the central Georgian-quarter walk. Specify Rose Lane: other Black Cat branches exist.

## Beer

Three rotating cask beers covering modern and traditional styles according to CAMRA's July 2026 update.
